projects.name: Happy Stats
projects.longDescription: Happy Stats is a lightweight analytics dashboard built for developers who want clear insights without complex setup. It visualizes metrics like commits, deployments, and project activity in a fast, privacy-friendly way.
projects.additionalDescription: Beyond the technical build, Happy Stats was also an exercise in product thinking. I wanted to design analytics that developers would actually enjoy using — clear typography, instant feedback, and no unnecessary clutter. Every chart was tested against real-world commit data to make sure it told a story at a glance. Building it reminded me how powerful simple, focused tools can be when they're made by someone who uses them every day.
highlights: Built a modular charting system using Recharts for clean, customizable visuals
Designed a real-time update flow powered by Supabase subscriptions
Implemented role-based dashboards for teams and solo developers
Optimized queries for large datasets using PostgreSQL window functions

projects.name: Streamline
projects.longDescription: Streamline automates your business processes by connecting your tools and eliminating repetitive tasks. With a visual workflow builder and hundreds of integrations, it empowers teams to focus on work that matters.
projects.additionalDescription: Automation should feel empowering, not intimidating. We designed Streamline with non-technical users in mind, using visual metaphors and natural language descriptions that make complex workflows accessible. The goal was to give everyone superpowers.
highlights: Built a visual workflow editor with drag-and-drop simplicity
Created 200+ pre-built integrations with popular business tools
Implemented conditional logic and branching for complex workflows
Designed a monitoring dashboard with detailed execution logs
